title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)


Raise $100,000 EU  Earn 2,000 EU – Individuals | HNW | Small fund portfolios


Raise 5M EU  Earn 100,000 EU – UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios


Raise 10M EU  Earn 200,000 EU - UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 100M EU  Earn 2,000,000 EU - Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 1 Bill EU  Earn 20,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Raise 10 Bill EU  Earn 200,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Easy Next Step


Interested in joining the Magnum Equities Capital agent network?


Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:


Important Notes & Disclaimers


  • Magnum Equities does not require Capital Agents to hold securities licenses, as you are not directly soliciting or selling investment products. Only presenting partnership opportunity.
  • All commissions are distributed upon adequate clearing period.
  • All final post-placement due diligence, AML etc are handled internally by Magnum management.
  • This is a commission-only independent agent role. It is not an offer of employment, partnership, or representation, and no exclusivity or guarantees of earnings are provided.
  • Magnum Equities reserves the right to approve or reject capital partners at its sole discretion based on internal compliance protocols.

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE)

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.
  • Atuar em incidentes e ajudar a reduzir MTTR.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia usando melhores práticas em SRE;
  • Experiência em ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI ou AWS) ou híbridos;
  • Atuação com CI/CD (GitLab, ArgoCD e similares);
  • Experiência solida com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform e similares)
  • Automação e scripting (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell);
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel).
  • Domínio de containers e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering;
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Certificações em Cloud.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


We’re looking for Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller team — a group of passionate, collaborative developers building seamless on-platform experiences that help us acquire and activate high-value customers. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that drives company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the product development process — from ideation and prototyping to implementation and release.
  • Architect and build scalable systems supporting millions of users.
  • Contribute to design and architectural decisions shaping the future of our software systems.
  • Rapidly prototype and run A/B tests to validate and optimize user experiences.
  • Mentor teammates, conduct code reviews, and pair-program to support shared learning.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering Management to align technical solutions with business goals.


Tech Stacks

Languages

  • Elixir
  • Erlang
  • Ruby
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript

Frameworks & Libraries

  • React
  • Next.js
  • GraphQL

Technologies & Architecture

  • Kafka
  • AWS / Lambda
  • Microservices
  • RESTful APIs
  • Event-based architecture

Databases

  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Tools & Practices

  • Git / Version control
  • IDEs
  • Continuous integration & deployment tools
  • Testing frameworks and best practices
  • CMS (Prismic)
  • A/B Testing


What You Bring

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of web application development experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products.
  • Strong background in writing reliable, maintainable code and building reusable component libraries.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the core languages or frameworks listed above.
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and remote deployment tools.
  • Experience with event-based architectures, GraphQL, and database fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity about retail/e-commerce and enthusiasm for sustainability and circular economies.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with React, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Background in GraphQL and microservices architecture.
  • Experience developing eCommerce platforms or working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Familiarity with mobile development (iOS and/or Android) is a plus.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Python, Azure)
description:
• Projetar, estimar e implementar soluções em parceria com o time de produto.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar APIs REST para integração com sistemas de terceiros.
  • Implementar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços de dados, visualização e infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Configurar e manter pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps .
  • Revisar códigos (pull requests), garantindo qualidade, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir bugs e gargalos de desempenho.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias de dados e nuvem.


Requisitos:

  • +6 anos de experiência em Python e SQL .
  • Domínio em Azure , especialmente em soluções de dados e visualização.
  • Experiência em APIs REST , DevOps/GitOps , testes automatizados e IaC .
  • Conhecimento em pipelines distribuídos e CI/CD (Azure DevOps) .
  • Capacidade de revisão técnica e mentoria de equipe.
  • Conhecimento em JSON , padrões de design e boas práticas de segurança .
  • Atuação em ambientes Agile/Scrum .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Docker e Linux .
  • Conhecimento em C# para suporte a sistemas legados.


Idioma:

  • Inglês avançado (B2+) .

title: Salesforce Developer (AI-Integrated)
description:
Salesforce Developer (AI-Integrated / Remote – EST Hours)

Contract: Long Term

Location: 100% Remote (must work EST hours)


About the Role


Our client, a leading U.S.-based financial technology organization, is building a high-performing nearshore Salesforce team to support its next-generation digital transformation initiatives. The team operates in an agile “Tiger Team ” model — small, cross-functional groups working closely with product teams to deliver impactful solutions at speed.


This is an exciting opportunity for a Salesforce Developer who’s passionate about problem-solving, eager to learn, and ready to work with AI-enhanced Salesforce tools to improve productivity and efficiency across the enterprise.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions across multiple business units.
  • Contribute to all technical aspects of Salesforce projects, integrations, and enhancements.
  • Collaborate within “Tiger Teams” to deliver rapid, high-impact technical outcomes.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following Salesforce best practices.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Support rollout and deployment of enhancements across production environments.
  • Work with AI-related Salesforce features such as Prompt Builder , Topics , Actions , and Agents .


Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Apex , Lightning Components , and Salesforce configuration.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required (Developer II or AI-related certs are a plus).
  • Experience with Sales Cloud , Service Cloud , or Communities preferred.
  • Familiarity with integrations using SQL , Azure , or middleware tools.
  • Fluent English communication (written and spoken).
  • Curious, growth-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for learning new technologies, especially AI.

title: Consultor
description:
Descrição da Empresa APVS Brasil é uma associação de proteção veicular devidamente cadastrada na Susep, com atuação nacional, oferecendo segurança, agilidade e cobertura completa, com foco em transparência, inovação e excelência no atendimento.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Consultor de Proteção Veicular para se juntar à nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. Este cargo envolve a venda e consultoria de serviços de proteção veicular, atendendo clientes e oferecendo o melhor serviço sob medida para suas necessidades. As responsabilidades diárias incluem realizar prospecção de novos clientes, atendimento pós-venda, administração de contratos e esclarecimento de dúvidas sobre os serviços prestados. Este é um cargo presencial e hibrido.

Qualificações

  • Vendas e Prospecção: Experiência em vendas, prospecção de novos clientes e habilidade para negociar e fechar negócios.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidade para oferecer um atendimento de qualidade, responder a dúvidas dos clientes e fornecer um suporte eficiente.
  • Administração: Capacidades administrativas para gerenciar contratos e manter registros precisos das vendas e interações com clientes.
  • Além das habilidades acima, será considerado um diferencial ter conhecimentos sobre proteção veicular e experiência anterior na área de consultoria de vendas.

title: Developer Tools Fullstack Engineer
description:
About us:


Smarter Contact is the #1 messaging platform for real estate professionals in the U.S. Our SaaS product powers millions of conversations to close more deals through smart SMS, voice, and automation.


We’re a fast-growing SaaS with serious traction — and now we’re hiring an experienced Full Stack Engineer to build the internal systems, dev tools, and automation that keep our team moving fast and scaling smarter.


If you get excited about clean abstractions, developer productivity, and building tools that make everyone’s life better — we want to talk.



What You’ll Own:

  • Design and implement internal DevOps tools and automation systems
  • Build and maintain configuration management systems across multiple environments
  • Create simulation/mock environments for third-party API integrations
  • Develop and optimize Chrome extensions that improve internal workflows
  • Build internal reporting frameworks for operational and financial data
  • Create a layered permissions Admin Panel to reduce support load
  • Implement best-in-class monitoring, logging, and observability
  • Collaborate with developers, product, and ops to deliver tools that actually get used
  • Contribute to the architecture and design of our internal systems and services

title: ANALISTA DE OPERACOES DE CONTRATOS JR
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de ANALISTA DE OPERACOES DE CONTRATOS JR


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Responsabilidades:

- Apoiar na análise, elaboração e acompanhamento de contratos comerciais, administrativos e de prestação de serviços.

- Monitorar prazos, cláusulas, indicadores e demais informações contratuais.

- Auxiliar na solução de eventuais problemas e divergências contratuais.

- Colaborar na negociação de termos e condições contratuais.

- Realizar a organização e arquivamento da documentação contratual.

- Prestar suporte e orientações à equipe sobre procedimentos e questões contratuais.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Graduação completa

- Experiência em atividades relacionadas à gestão e operacionalização de contratos.

- Conhecimento em legislação e regulamentações contratuais.

- Habilidades de análise, negociação e resolução de problemas.

- Excelente comunicação oral e escrita.

- Proatividade, organização e atenção aos detalhes.

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de escritório (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Diferenciais:

- Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas.

- Experiência prévia em empresas de grande porte ou multinacionais.

- Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão de contratos.

title: Guidewire Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal.


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • At least 2 years of experience working with Guidewire (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter) ;
  • Strong experience in Guidewire Configuration, Integration, and GOSU development ;
  • Solid understanding of Guidewire Studio , Product Model , and Data Model ;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level).
  • Knowledge of Java and REST/SOAP web services is desirable;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional technical and interpersonal skills;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to adapt and evolve in a fast-changing environment.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a culture focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for? Let’s chat!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Join OSF Digital as a Backend Developer, where you will design and build server-side components using Java, ensuring clean and efficient code. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize backend performance and security while contributing to innovative digital experiences for our users.



Job Description


  • Backend Development:

Design and build server-side components, including APIs and databases, using Java and relevant frameworks, ensuring clean and maintainable code.

  • API Work:

Implement and integrate RESTful APIs, manage data validation, and handle errors, possibly integrating with external services.

  • Database Management:

Design and optimize databases for performance, maintain data integrity, and work with various database systems.

  • Testing & QA:

Conduct unit and integration tests to maintain code quality, identify bugs, and optimize performance.

  • Team Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams to meet project goals, requiring strong communication and teamwork skills.


Technical Competencies:


  • Java Programming:

Strong knowledge and experience in the Java programming language. Understanding of core concepts, syntax, and best practices.

  • Server-Side Development:

Experience in building server-side applications and APIs using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Relational Databases:

Proficiency in working with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database optimization.

  • Web Development:

Understanding of web development concepts and technologies such as HTTP, RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

  • Java Frameworks and Libraries:

Familiarity with popular Java frameworks and libraries such as Spring Framework, Hibernate, or Apache Kafka.

  • Unit Testing:

Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit. Knowledge of software testing principles and practices.

  • Version Control:

Proficiency in using version control systems like Git for code management and collaboration.


Analytical and Problem-Solving Competencies:


  • Analytical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in the backend code and infrastructure.

  • Performance Optimization:

Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, such as caching, indexing, and query optimization, to ensure efficient and scalable backend systems.


Cloud Experience:

  • Cloud Services:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. Ability to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment, leveraging cloud services for scalability and performance.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (LAMP)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience and strong problem-solving abilities, quickly learn new technologies and concepts, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. The client provides industry-leading software for environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance in the retail and commercial fuel industry. Their platform helps major fuel networks, including global brands, monitor and optimize their operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Technical Project Manager  – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms (Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components (CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net
description:
Company Overview

SEW is the #1 Energy and Water Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for Digital Customer Engagement, Field Workforce Engagement, and Smart AI/Machine Learning to the Energy and Utility sector. We empower utilities to enhance customer service, optimize operational efficiency, and maximize return on investments through the SEW platform applications leveraging mobile, AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies.

Searching for your dream job? At SEW, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing the way the world uses energy and water and become part of our innovative and talented team!


Position Overview

We are looking for a Mid Level Full Stack .Net Developer with good experience with C# and Angular to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust web and mobile applications that integrate seamlessly with SEW’s platform. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

Application Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Build responsive front-end interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Develop efficient and secure back-end services and APIs.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Perform thorough analysis of complex data and recommend actionable strategies.
  • Develop complex database queries in SQL/TSQL and NoSQL.
  • Translate client requirements to technical architectural specifications and communicate this to delivery teams and clients.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to define and implement solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality software development.

System Optimization:

  • Optimize application performance to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly.

Innovation and Best Practices:

  • Define data architecture requirements for cross-product integration within and across cloud-based platforms.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Advocate for and implement best practices in software development, including testing, security, and CI/CD processes.
  • Write test plans and test cases to ensure application integrity is maintained.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in software development and product deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with .Net Core, .Net Framework, Angular, Entity Framework, Git, Unit Tests and Pipelines.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Expertise in MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server (SAP HANA is a plus).
  • Experience with cloud architecture, including AWS, Azure, and Google (SAP BTP is a plus).
  • Effectively translate data modeling and BI requirements into the design process.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent human relations and documentation skills.
  • Strong ability to interpret customer and market insights and conduct data analysis.
  • Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.


Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.


SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: Desenvolvedor de aplicativos
description:
Procura-se: Desenvolvedor(a) de Aplicativo para evento

O desafio: desenvolver um app interativo que permita ao público acompanhar, em tempo real, a jornada de um veiculo e participar da ação promocional.

O que o app precisa entregar:

Mapa interativo com a localização atual do veiculo

Visualização da rota completa com pontos de parada

Previsão de chegada em cada ponto

Painel administrativo para gerenciar rotas e deslocamentos

Atualização em tempo real da posição

Design esperado:

Interface minimalista e elegante (paleta azul e branco)

Mapa em tela cheia como elemento central

Cards flutuantes com informações da ação

Animações suaves de transição

100% responsivo para mobile

Arquitetura:

Entidades: veículo, rotas, paradas

Componentes modulares para mapa, marcadores e estimativas

Layout com navegação intuitiva

Desenvolvedor(a) com experiência em apps de geolocalização e tempo real

Domínio de frameworks mobile (React Native, Flutter ou similares)

Capacidade de integrar APIs de mapas (Google Maps / Mapbox) e sistemas de tracking. Interessados, entrem em contato enviando mensagem para conversar sobre prazos, orçamento e escopo.

title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a talented and visionary Product Designer with a strong command of user interface design to elevate the intuitive nature and value of our SaaS platform through innovative designs rooted in customer feedback.


About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedulethat are directly aligned with customer needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.


What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.


At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

title: Sênior React
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Analista de Suporte Técnico - Trilingue
description:
InvGate is a fast growing SaaS company that develops products for IT management and service automation, used by clients in over 60 countries in industries such as banking, e-commerce, education and technology.


To support our continuous growth we are looking for a Trilingual Technical Support Analyst to join our team.


Some of the role's responsibilities include providing technical and functional support to clients worldwide through different channels such as email, tickets, and remote sessions (Teamviewer/Zoom/etc), checking clients' configurations, suggesting improvements and best practices to maximize the platform's efficiency, and working closely with the development and customer success teams to troubleshoot issues.


Do not hesitate to apply if you…


  • are fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese (native-level portuguese strongly preffered, C1 level is the minimum required)
  • enjoy working with clients, providing top-level support
  • think analytically
  • have strong communication and troubleshooting skills
  • have previous experience in technical support for software and/or infrastructure
  • are tech-savvy


Having previous experience using InvGate products is a big plus!



If you want to know more about us, please visit

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET Sênior
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 53854


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor C# (.Net/Core) com conhecimento em Oracle e SQL Server, Windows Forms, API, Angular.
  • Experiência com desenho orientado a objeto, padrões de design, clean code.
  • Conhecimento de GIT, experiência de participar em um projeto desde requisitos de escopo até o lançamento, experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas e escaláveis.


Desejável:

  • Conhecimento de mercado financeiro.
  • Renda variavel Conhecimento de React, Azure, SQL Server, Data plataform (Hazelcast, Redis)


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Strong Familiarity with Data warehouses (Snowflake, SQL)

Proficiency in writing performant SQL queries Scripts to generate business insights and drive better organization decision making

Experiences with cloud technologies (Ex Snowflake Azure)

Experience with Agile based development

Problem solving skills

Self-Starter - willing to ask questions

English is mandatory

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Conduzir projetos estratégicos garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, escopo, orçamento e qualidade, promovendo comunicação eficaz entre stakeholders e equipes técnicas e de negócio.

Responsabilidades

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo dos projetos: iniciação, planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento;

Liderar reuniões de alinhamento, definição de cronogramas, e acompanhamento de entregas;

Atuar como ponto focal entre áreas técnicas e áreas de negócio;

Elaborar e manter cronogramas, planos de comunicação, RACI e relatórios executivos;

Gerenciar escopo, riscos, orçamento e recursos dos projetos;

Garantir a aplicação de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban, etc.);

Facilitar a resolução de impedimentos e conflitos entre áreas envolvidas;

Apoiar a governança de projetos, assegurando a documentação e controle das entregas;

Reportar status e KPIs do projeto à alta gestão.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON: ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.
